اعتمدتما (form VIII)
# اِعْتَمَدْتُمَا (iʕtamadtumā) /iʕ.ta.mad.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# اُعْتُمِدْتُمَا (uʕtumidtumā) /uʕ.tu.mid.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
